summary: Ascentage Pharma filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated November 4, 2026 and a same-content announcement dated November 5, 2026, disclosing that multiple clinical and preclinical studies across four proprietary candidates—olverembatinib (HQP1351), lisaftoclax (APG-2575), APG-5918 and APG-3288—were selected for presentation at the 68th ASH Annual Meeting, December 12-15, 2026, in New Orleans, including a first-disclosure oral presentation of APG-5918 in relapsed/refractory T-cell lymphoma. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, ownership or regulatory mechanics are stated; this is a routine scientific-data disclosure, not a special situation.
